Definition: {to approach (causatively, bring near) for whatever purpose}
BiblicalUsage: Darius orders that sacrifices be brought near — offered — to the God of heaven, and in Daniel the Chaldeans come near to accuse the Jews. The same word draws near to accuse and draws near to worship.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe nearness cuts both ways: men come near to accuse, but God invites us to come near and offer.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
